title: Shrimp Curry with Jamaican Flair
description: A spicy and flavorful curry dish featuring succulent shrimp, inspired by the bold flavors of Jamaica. Serve over rice or with naan bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
In a small bowl, mix together the curry powder, smoky paprika, and dried thyme.
Sprinkle the spice mixture over the shrimp and stir to combine.
Add the hot sauce and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the shrimp over rice or with naan bread and garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Adjust the seasoning as needed and serve immediately.
